blocking_reasons: fresh explicit user authorization bound to exact I096 packet hash is absent
fresh DNS resolution evidence is absent
fresh pinned public address set is absent
notes: I096 exact scope and packet hashes were recomputed with canonical sorted compact JSON and match the recorded hashes.

The verifier requires any future authorization artifact to name both the exact I096 packet hash and scope hash, authorize only one anonymous read-only GET, forbid credentials/value movement, and be unexpired.
Fresh execution evidence must be bound to the same packet/scope, include policy/DNS/TLS hashes and a non-empty pinned public-address set, be temporally valid, and require anti-rebinding revalidation.
The verifier itself contains no network transport and can never produce an execution token.
